text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Aah—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (The sensation of dashing across the turf and tearing through the wind still clings to my body, as if it's etched into me.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Forward, ahead, toward victory.
The heat burning through my life...
beats like a racing drum within my chest—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It's burning hot...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—This is the start of my Twinkle Series.
My very first step...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: —Mejiro Ramonu's little sister put up quite a fight. Wonder how close she can get to her legendary sister.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Hmm. But the standard of comparison is the 'Mejiro Treasure' herself... Ramonu's running really is on another level.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (...Even if it is still an unreachable light right now—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Someday, I will definitely etch my brilliance
across this entire venue...!)
When I went to welcome Mejiro Ardan after her debut race—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I was able
to give everything of my "current" self.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"However, that is...
still only within myself."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I have not yet managed to engrave the trails of my light into the hearts of those present at this venue.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
For "now," looking through me,
they are merely reminded of Onee-sama's majesty,
but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Someday, I hope to etch my own brilliance into everyone's hearts.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's head straight back and—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Today's... ngh—!

Mejiro Ardan suddenly nearly collapsed.
I rushed to catch her and confirmed she was conscious, but she was completely exhausted.

Immediately after that,
I had to be rushed to the hospital—

After a thorough medical examination confirmed there was nothing immediately critical,
Mejiro Ardan's condition had also started to recover a bit.

To be safe, however, Mejiro Ardan had to be
admitted to a Mejiro family rest house
for complete bed rest that day...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...I apologize.
I am sorry for causing you concern."
choice_data_list: For now, I'm just glad nothing serious happened...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
—Trainer-sama.
Do you have a moment?
There is something I would like to discuss.

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text: Well then, this way...
choice_data_list: Aldan, get some proper rest today.
Aldan, make sure you get plenty of rest today, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...I shall take you up on that.
Guided to a private room by the Mejiro family's physician, I took a seat as offered.
choice_data_list: So, what did you want to talk about...?

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
"Regarding Lady Ardan's condition...
To put it simply――"

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
I believe it is best for Milady to step away from racing for a time
and rest at this retreat for an extended period.
In other words—

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
I ask that you reconsider whether there is truly
any need to rush into the Twinkle Series right now.
That is all from my perspective.

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
"—This issue was likely caused by the immense toll on the young lady's
mind and body from the main race, manifesting all at once as stress."

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
Physical fatigue from training.
Mental tension, or perhaps pressure,
arising from an impending race—

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
And because it was a real, serious match,
the exhaustion was incomparable to mere training.

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
"All of it surged like a muddy torrent over Milady,
just as her tension slightly eased after finishing the race—"

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text: "Supposing that the Young Lady continues to challenge major races in the future, the burden will inevitably become far greater than it was today."

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
"...As for just how fierce it will be,
I believe Trainer-sama can imagine it best of all."

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
...Even I understand how much racing means to the young lady.
I have no intention of brushing that aside.

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
Ultimately, the decision lies with the young lady.
However, Trainer, I ask that you keep this in mind as well...
After speaking with the Mejiro family's physician, Mejiro Ardan's nanny drove me back to the academy—

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text:
—Trainer-sama. Allow me to thank you once more
for coming to the young lady's aid today.
On behalf of the Mejiro family, you have our gratitude.
choice_data_list: No, not at all... I really didn't do much—
No, not at all... I really didn't do much—

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text:
…………Just a moment ago, the Master and Mistress
had a word with Lady Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, they want me to rethink my choice
to live in the racing world one more time.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text:
I have served the young lady since her childhood.
It is not difficult for me to imagine what she desires and what pains her heart right now.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text: ...With that in mind, there is a request I must make of the Trainer who will walk alongside the young lady at this academy.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text: —Please, choose whatever is best for you, Milady.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text:
I believe that as the one chosen by Milady,
you will be able to accomplish it.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I shall take my leave.
Good night, Trainer—

...What truly is the best choice
for Mejiro Ardan?

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
I ask that you reconsider whether there is truly
any need to rush into the Twinkle Series right now.
That is all from my perspective.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, they want me to rethink my choice
to live in the racing world one more time.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...Ardan-san said that earlier,
but I still believe in her."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"For Ardan-san to run her debut race to the end,
and to run together with me and Yaeno-san!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It fades quickly and is soon forgotten.
âEven so, this 'now' matters.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Risking my life to make this very moment shine
is the one and only privilege permitted to me.

—Mejiro Ardan's words from that day
continue to echo inside me.

"...Indeed.
I have long since made up my mind."
The resolve to remain Mejiro Ardan's trainer.

"Then as her Trainer,
I must simply do what needs to be done...!"
